global_warnings: The May 29 to June 1 four-task reports label their paired baseline as vanilla SimVLA, but both runners loaded the default modified checkpoint ckpt-60000. Treat those experiments as modified SimVLA versus modified SimVLA plus the base risk detector.

Bob and Dean are separate hardware replications. Their closed-loop outcomes are not expected to match episode-for-episode even with identical seeds because GPU-level numerical differences alter generated actions.

A result is canonical only when its checkpoint, runner, detector artifacts, reset-seed manifest, action-seed protocol, and raw episode summaries are all identified. Aggregate-only reports are evidence summaries, not substitutes for raw logs.

rules.title: Four-task risk-aware campaign
rules.meaning: Modified SimVLA ckpt-60000 plus the v2_018 base risk detector and ACE candidate selection.
rules.trust: paired result; checkpoint semantics corrected on 2026-06-05
rules.warning: This is not a comparison against original SimVLA.

rules.title: Paired no-risk baseline for the four-task campaign
rules.meaning: Modified SimVLA ckpt-60000 without ACE selection or risk-based action replacement. Reset seeds match the corresponding risk-aware campaign.
rules.trust: paired result; checkpoint semantics corrected on 2026-06-05
rules.warning: Older reports call this vanilla SimVLA; that label is incorrect.

rules.title: Canonical four-policy Task 0 replication
rules.meaning: Back-to-back 100-episode comparison of original SimVLA, modified ckpt-60000, base risk-aware policy, and top-8 uncertainty risk-aware policy.
rules.warning: Interpret Bob and Dean as separate replications, not identical trajectory replays.

rules.title: Conservative top-8 intervention pilot
rules.meaning: Small active pilot testing stricter intervention rules for the top-8 uncertainty risk model.
rules.trust: experimental; do not use as a final result until completion audit
rules.warning: Status and conclusions may change while the run is active.

rules.title: Selected base transformer risk detector
rules.meaning: Offline detector family selected before adding the new SimVLA uncertainty features. Includes global, task-ID OOD, and object-holdout variants.
rules.checkpoint: risk detector artifacts; policy data were generated with the modified SimVLA pipeline

rules.title: Current Dean risk models
rules.meaning: The two retained detector families: base transformer and the same transformer with eight selected uncertainty dimensions in the static branch.
rules.checkpoint: base and unc_topk8 detector model.pt artifacts

rules.title: Top-K uncertainty feature sweep
rules.meaning: Offline comparison of 8, 16, and 32 selected uncertainty dimensions on the all-task and held-out-task splits.

rules.title: All-task uncertainty input test
rules.meaning: In-distribution comparison between the base transformer and direct 98D uncertainty input using all available tasks.

rules.title: Held-out last-two-task-IDs experiment
rules.meaning: OOD split holding out the last two task IDs from each suite while using all other valid episodes for train, validation, and calibration.

rules.title: Early Task 7 first-action comparison
rules.meaning: Historical 100-seed first-action receding-horizon comparison. Both policy paths used the modified ckpt-60000 sampler, despite reports using the word vanilla for the baseline.
rules.trust: raw canonical 100-episode summaries exist; checkpoint label corrected on 2026-06-05
rules.warning: The observed 58% versus 61% result does not compare against original SimVLA.

rules.title: Task 7 full-chunk execution experiment
rules.meaning: Historical experiment executing full action chunks instead of only the first action. The 100-episode full-chunk baseline reached 98 successes, but it used the modified ckpt-60000 sampler.
rules.trust: baseline replicated and spot-checked; risk-aware run was interrupted and later archived
rules.warning: Do not combine this result with first-action rollouts or present it as original SimVLA performance.

rules.title: Archived material
rules.meaning: Preserved historical or rejected work. It is retained for provenance but should not be treated as the current selected method.
